title: The effects of ‘small private online course + flipped classroom’ teaching on job competency of nuclear medicine training trainees
reason: Randomised comparison of SPOC plus flipped classroom vs lecture-based learning for nuclear-medicine residents on pre-class, after-class and final test scores plus satisfaction questionnaires. Only group contrasts; no per-student platform indicator is related to outcomes.

extraction.n_quote: A total of 103 first-year residents from Sichuan Provincial People’s Hospital were randomly assigned to either an experimental group ( n = 52) or a control group ( n = 51)
extraction.population: first-year standardized-training residents (postgraduate medical training), 1 hospital
extraction.outcome_or_construct: theoretical test and final exam scores; competency/satisfaction questionnaire (self-report)
extraction.notes: Residents decided on other criteria per rule (E3 not applied).
